provenance.source: Accepted outputs from the existing eleven original Mr Lister artwork fixtures, recorded by tests/evaluation/test_live_bedrock.py.
provenance.capture_limit: The source artifacts retained finalized listing tags, not the original ranked tag_candidates. Matching private diagnostics did not retain raw model output.
provenance.interpretation: Analysis and listing fields are preserved exactly as recorded. Tags are historical old-selector outputs, not expected new-selector outputs. These references do not constitute an old/new selector A/B comparison or endorse every recorded model claim.
provenance.privacy: Only original synthetic-artwork evaluation content and source hashes are included; no credentials, request identifiers, or private diagnostic records. Tests do not read private artifacts.
